options.text: i - d, ii - a, iii - c, iv - b

solution:
The correct answer is __**i - b, ii - d, iii - a, iv - c**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **M1** represents the narrowest measure of money supply and includes:

 
 
• Currency in circulation (C)
 
• Demand deposits (Dd)
 
• Other deposits (Od)
 
 
 
• **M2 **is a broader measure of money supply and includes all components of M1 plus:
 
 
• Time deposits (Td)
 
• Savings deposits (S) 
 
 
 
• **M3** is an even broader measure and includes all components of M2 plus:
 
 
• Term deposits of non-banking public (TPOd)
 
 
 
• M4 is the broadest measure of money supply and encompasses all components of M3 plus:
 
 
• Post office savings bank deposits (POSBd) 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **The money supply** refers to the aggregate sum of money circulating within an economy, encompassing physical currency, coins, and funds held in bank accounts. 
 
• It is typically understood as a collection of secure assets accessible to households and businesses for conducting transactions or as short-term investment vehicles.
